modules.name: ISW-α: Specter the Unchained's Specialized Module

stages.effectText: In Integrated Strategies , both self and <Substitute> deals 40% increased Physical and Arts damage and receives 40% less Physical and Arts damage.

<Substitute> reduces the Movement Speed of nearby ground enemies by 40%, and deals 40% ATK Arts damage to them per second. In Integrated Strategies, Substitute deals additional 100% ATK Arts damage per second.

<Substitute> reduces the Movement Speed of nearby ground enemies by 40%, and deals 40% ATK Arts damage to them per second. In Integrated Strategies, Substitute deals additional 160% ATK Arts damage per second. When other operators in surrounding tiles receives Lethal Damage, if Specter the Unchained is not in Substitute state, said operators HP will not go down below 1 for 8 seconds, during which, said operator will apply Specter the Unchained's First Talent to surrounding enemies. After the duration ends, Specter will switch to her Substitute. This can only be triggered once and will be refreshed once Substitute swaps back to original self.
